summary_1line: Karna is recognized as a charioteer’s son and mocked, Duryodhana defends him; later Drona sends the princes to capture Drupada, where Arjuna and Bhima dominate the battle.

image_candidates.scene_text: Newly crowned Karna, still wet from coronation waters, bows as the old charioteer Adhiratha rushes in trembling and embraces him with tears.
Duryodhana rises in fury in the arena, pointing at Karna while challenging anyone present to mount a chariot and oppose him.
Bhima charges into the elephant ranks with his mace, smashing the massive beasts so they fall like shattered mountains across the battlefield.
